reasoning: Mästlin's 1581 Latin treatise on the comet of 1580 has never been translated into English. Historians note it is 'considerably inferior' to his 1577 comet work and attracts far less scholarly attention. The only Mästlin comet work in English is the 1618 manuscript treatise (Granada/Boner, Brill 2022).
